# Contributing

Setup and commands are in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), which is written for people as much as
for agents.

- `main` accepts squash-merged pull requests with every required check green.
- The PR title becomes the commit on `main`, so it must be a conventional commit (`feat:`,
  `fix:`, `docs:`, …); a required check enforces it.
- Change behaviour and the doc that describes it in the same PR.
